decisionsTitle: «Ordinea meniului»: one order for every entry of the site menu (amending §537)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-09-29, from a screenshot of «Pagini» → «Paginile clubului»:** «la paginile clubului, vreau să pot seta ordinea la orice pagină, inclusiv cea de evenimente, calendar, contact». Until now only the custom pages carried an order (the «Ordinea» column and its ↑ / ↓, §537), the platform's own sections had the places `SECTIONS` in `SiteNav` gave them (§537, after §251), and a rule stood between the two groups.

**Decision: one order for every entry the menu can carry.** Each entry has a stable key — `events`, `calendar`, `contact`, `gallery`, `team`, `faq`, `members`, and `page:<id>` for a custom page (its id, never its address, which differs per language). «Galerie» is in the list too: it is an entry of the same menu, and leaving it out would have left one entry with a place nobody can change. The club's order is one list of those keys, first to last, stored as one `platform_settings` row, `menuOrder` — no migration, the table takes any key (§100). The save is audited (`menu_order.changed`, from and to).

**The merge rule** (`src/modules/content/menu/order.ts`, the one function the header, the footer and the backoffice card all call): the stored list rules; an entry it does not name — a fresh site with no list, a page written after the last save, a section a later release adds — falls to the end in today's default order (the sections as §537 lists them, then the custom pages); a key for something that no longer exists (a deleted page) is dropped. So a fresh site and a new page need no setting up, and a new page appears last until it is moved.

**One truth with the old «Ordinea» column.** The stored list is the order. The `nav_order` column stays only as the fallback order of the pages the list does not name yet, which is the order the site showed before this change — so the first view of the card is today's menu, and the first «Salvează ordinea» stores the whole list, after which the list rules. Nothing is copied by a migration. The page editor's «Ordinea în meniu» box is gone (a posted `navOrder` is ignored), the list's ↑ / ↓ on each custom page and `movePageInNav` are gone, and a new page is written with `nav_order` one past the largest, so a page the list does not name is last rather than first. Dropping the column would be a contract migration of its own; nothing needs it now. The published pages are read in `nav_order`, then the date they were written — no longer the title after the number, which sorted two equal numbers differently in each language.

**The screen.** On «Pagini» → «Paginile clubului», between the standard pages and the custom ones, a fold «Ordinea meniului» (its glyph a reorder mark, §521) lists every entry in the current order, each with its number, its glyph and its name, a custom page marked «pagină personalizată». «Sus» and «Jos», each with its arrow and named with the entry for a screen reader, move one place; the focus stays on the pressed button (its twin at an end), a polite status says the new place, and a line says the order is not saved yet. One «Salvează ordinea» posts the whole list behind the §384 question («Schimbi ordinea meniului?»); a refused save keeps the order as moved (§315). The buttons are the way to reorder — a keyboard and a thumb reach them alike — so there is no drag, and no dependency. An entry the menu leaves out today (a draft standard page, «Echipa» with no card on the site, an unpublished custom page, «Contact» with nowhere to write, «Galerie» with no published album) keeps its place, greyed, «nu apare încă»: the card asks the header's own questions (`src/modules/content/menu/on-site.ts`, moved there from `SiteHeader`), so it never disagrees with the site. The custom pages' table shows each page's place in the whole menu («Locul în meniu») in the same order.

**Who.** A club setting, the Administrator's (§450): `saveMenuOrderAction` asks `canManageClubSettings` at the door and `saveMenuOrder` asserts it again; an Organizer or a Redactor sees the list without its buttons and a line saying the Administrator sets it (BR-REQ-060-01). A post that is not a list of keys is refused as a forged one.

**The readers.** The header's row and its ☰ menu sort their entries by the stored order — the members' entry still only while «Beneficiile membrilor» is on the site (§524), each other conditional entry by its own rule, the active entry as before — and the rule between the platform's sections and the club's pages is gone: the menu is one list. §537's order (criterion 158 of BR-REQ-041-01) is now the default the merge rule falls back to, not the only order. The footer's fold carries two of the menu's entries, «Întrebări frecvente» and «Contact»: «Întrebări frecvente» stays on the first line after the terms and «Înscrierile mele» while the order puts it first, and follows the contact line when the club puts it after «Contact»; the rest of the fold is not the menu and keeps its place. The order is read through the public cache under `settings` with the last good copy (§333, §447), so a database that cannot answer is today's default order, never a page that fails over its menu; a save expires `settings`, so every public page shows the new order from the next view (§549).
changelogLine: - **«Ordinea meniului»: one order for the whole site menu** — on «Pagini» → «Paginile clubului» an Administrator puts every entry of the menu in order — Evenimente, Calendar, Contact, Galerie, Echipa, Întrebări frecvente, Membri and the club's own pages — with «Sus» / «Jos» and one confirmed save; the header and the footer follow it, the rule between the platform's sections and the club's pages is gone, a new page comes last, and an entry not on the site yet keeps its place, greyed. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: An Administrator orders every entry of the site menu — «Evenimente», «Calendar», «Contact», «Galerie», «Echipa», «Întrebări frecvente», «Membri» and each custom page — in one list on «Pagini» → «Paginile clubului» → «Ordinea meniului», with «Sus» / «Jos» and one confirmed «Salvează ordinea»; the order is one `platform_settings` value of keys (`page:<id>` for a custom page), an entry it does not name (a fresh site, a page written after the save) falls to the end in the default order, a deleted page's key is dropped, and an entry not on the site keeps its place, greyed «nu apare încă» (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The page editor has no order box and the custom pages' list no ↑ / ↓: a new page is written after every page there is, so it is last in the menu until it is moved, and the list shows each page's place in the whole menu (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Saving «Ordinea meniului» is the Administrator's: the action and the service both refuse an Organizer and a Redactor, storing and expiring nothing, and they see the order without its buttons (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The public menu — the header's row and its ☰ menu — draws the sections and the club's pages in the club's one order, with no rule between them, each conditional entry still shown only by its own rule; the footer's fold draws «Întrebări frecvente» before or after «Contact» as that order puts them; saving the order expires the public pages' `settings` (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: one menu order for every entry of the site menu, set on «Pagini» → «Ordinea meniului»
